tank
Tank and radiator tubes
The oil enclosure and curved external cooling tubes are modeled together in the source Base part. The tank holds the active assembly; radiator surfaces transfer heat to the surroundings.
The source has three solids in this part. This academic model shows tubular radiators; it does not have the conservator and fan arrangement of the substation model.
Source Base, drawing items 28 and 17; dimension sheet 1/2
lid
Main lid
The bolted lid closes the oil tank and supports the high-voltage bushings and inspection cover.
Gaskets seal the tank joint. Removing the lid here is an inspection view, not a maintenance procedure.
Source tampa; dimension sheet 1/2, VISTA SUP. TAMPA
hv-bushings
High-voltage bushings
Three ribbed porcelain bushing bodies carry insulated terminals through the grounded enclosure.
The ribs increase surface creepage distance. Terminal fasteners remain separate source parts. No insulation rating is inferred.
Source isolador porcelana and terminal screws; drawing items 42, 1–2
lv-terminals
Low-voltage terminal assemblies
Four external terminal fittings are represented by the xbase source parts and their fasteners.
These are the external low-voltage connection assemblies shown in the exploded drawing. Their count alone does not establish the winding connection or neutral arrangement.
Source xbase family; exploded drawing items 21–24
lv-coils
Low-voltage coils · BT
Three inner coil bodies surround the three core limbs. The drawing calls these BOBINA BT, with diameter 26 mm and height 43 mm.
Each inner coil is nested inside a high-voltage coil. Their concentric placement is taken from the actual source assembly. Modeled ribs are not a verified electrical turns count.
Source bobina22 and bobina22_MIR; dimension sheet 1/2, BOBINA BT; exploded item 12
hv-coils
High-voltage coils · AT
Three outer cylindrical coil bodies enclose the low-voltage coils. The drawing calls these BOBINA AT, diameter 30 mm and height 43 mm.
The outer coil is electrically insulated from the inner coil and core. The turns ratio determines voltage ratio, but this source provides no winding turns or rated ratio.
Source bobina1 and bobina1_MIR; dimension sheet 1/2, BOBINA AT; exploded item 13
core-limbs
Magnetic core limbs
Three rectangular core limbs pass through the coil centers. The drawing specifies a 17.4 mm square profile and 86 mm length.
The limbs and yokes form the magnetic circuit that links the coils. The model shows the solid core profile rather than individual laminations.
Source bobina4 and bobina4_MIR; dimension sheet 1/2, BOBINA NUCLEO; exploded item 14
lower-yokes
Lower core yokes
Two lower core sections join adjacent limbs at the bottom of the active assembly.
Although the source filename says bobina_interna, the rectangular geometry and drawing identify core pieces. They are not inner windings.
Source bobina_interna; exploded item 30, NÚCLEO INFERIOR
upper-yoke
Upper core yoke
The upper rectangular core bar measures 75 × 17.4 × 5 mm in the source drawing.
It bridges the top of the three core limbs, completing the core path with the lower yokes. Nearby clamp members are separate mechanical parts.
Source peça alfa 3; dimension sheet 1/2, NÚCLEO SUP.; exploded item 34
coil-end-rings
Coil end rings
Six annular end rings sit above and below the three coil pairs.
The rings locate the coil assembly; small spacer blocks between the rings and coils are separate geometry.
Source bobina3 family; exploded item 10, ANEL BOBINA
coil-spacers
Coil spacers
Small repeated blocks separate and support the coil ends and end rings.
These are visible mechanical insulation supports in the source. Their material and dielectric rating are not certified by the CAD file.
Source pecinha_bobina family; exploded item 11, ISO. ANEL BOBINA
tap-hardware
Tap-changing mechanism and supports
The source includes a selector assembly, pins, linkage and support members identified as comutador.
A tap changer changes the effective winding connection to adjust ratio. This model does not verify a live operating sequence or on-load capability.
Source comutador assembly; exploded items 35–37; dimension sheet 2/2
internal-leads
Internal connection conductors
Four conductive solids are included in the source trifasico_bifasico part.
Their geometry can be inspected, but a schematic is required to assign a delta/star circuit or map every terminal.
Actual STEP source part; no verified electrical netlist
core-supports
Core clamps and insulating supports
Clamp bars, studs and wooden support shapes hold the active assembly in position.
These parts carry mechanical loads and maintain spacing around the core and coils.
Source peça alfa / madeira / stud families; exploded drawing
seals-covers
Gaskets, covers and clamps
Separate seals, inspection cover, lid clamps and mounting hardware surround the tank opening.
These provide sealing, closure and mechanical restraint. The source does not specify oil type or leakage performance.
Source vedacao, tampa_sup and presilha families
earthing-lug
Enclosure earthing lug
The source includes grounding attachment hardware on the enclosure.
An enclosure bond is distinct from the transformer winding circuit. The model contains no complete grounding network.
Source fix_aterramento family; exploded drawing
hardware
Other source fittings and fasteners
The remaining actual source parts include standards-named bolts, nuts, washers and several unnamed fittings.
Source names and positions are preserved. Unidentified fittings remain available for inspection without an invented electrical role.
